name: sapikenal
description: SapiKenal monorepo — cattle breed identification foundation

scripts.backend:test: cd apps/backend && docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/ -v
scripts.backend:migrate: cd apps/backend && docker compose run --rm backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:seed-admin: cd apps/backend && docker compose run --rm backend python -m scripts.seed_admin
scripts.mobile:deploy: cd apps/mobile && bash ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ../.. && node scripts/run-adb.mjs install -r apps/mobile/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
scripts.mobile:run: cd apps/mobile && bash ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ../.. && node scripts/run-adb.mjs install -r apps/mobile/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am start -n id.sapikenal.app/.MainActivity
scripts.mobile:restart: node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am force-stop id.sapikenal.app && node scripts/run-adb.mjs shell am start -n id.sapikenal.app/.MainActivity
scripts.test: pnpm run backend:test && pnpm run web:test && pnpm run mobile:test
scripts.build: pnpm run backend:build && pnpm run web:build
